predictions.claim: Baseline. The null mutant (the unmutated pinned files in a scratch copy), re-extracted from scratch with I17, I19 (with A19) and I18 and projected onto the holon-facts/0.1 header schema, decides M0 exactly as results/M0 does (L_par_hdr_v0, L_par_hdr_v1, L_rt_go_v0, L_rt_go_v1, L_rt_go_v2 PROVED; L_par_hdr_v2, L_par_hdr_ssvh, L_dom_hdr REFUTED), M1x as results/M2/differential.json 'extracted' (7 PROVED, 7 REFUTED, L_tag_BVH UNKNOWN) and M2 as results/M2 (6 PROVED, 4 UNKNOWN, 2 REFUTED). Its extraction succeeds and its projection has no error.

Stratum A totals and M2 exit (b). 96 of the 192 stratum-A mutants are killed (rate_all 96/192 = 0.5), none ends in error, no law outside a predicted set satisfies K1 or K2, and no law is a replay disagreement or a baseline finding. rate_non_equivalent of stratum A is below 0.80, so M2 exit (b) is not met: with no killed mutant equivalent it would need at least 72 of the 96 survivors adjudicated equivalent.

Kills per operator in stratum A (killed/mutants): mstore_offset 21/22, shl_width 8/12, drop_delete 0/7, swap_cursor 0/12, cmp_boundary 2/23, cmp_boundary_mirror 1/15, mload_offset 0/22, shr_width 0/9, putuint64_offset 14/14, copy_offset 26/28, drop_len_check 0/4, go_slice_offset 24/24.

mstore_offset (the K of mstore(add(p, K), v) to K-1 and K+1 at the 11 codec store sites): 21 of 22 killed. Where the shifted store leaves no byte unwritten (A001, A003-A006, A008, A021) the kill is K1; where it leaves one (A002, A007, A009-A017, A019, A020, A022) the model has no witness and the kill is K2 alone, the code's fresh memory reading 0 at the unwritten byte. A001-A020 are killed by all five non-REFUTED codec laws, A021-A022 by L_par_hdr_v1, L_rt_go_v1 and L_rt_go_v2. A018 (the sequencer-set store at 186) survives, filed proof_lost_unwitnessed on those five laws: its only unwritten byte, 185, is 0 in the code as the ssvh = 0 premise wants.

shl_width: the 8 codec-store mutants (A027-A034) are killed by K1, A027-A032 by the five non-REFUTED codec laws and A033-A034 by L_par_hdr_v1, L_rt_go_v1 and L_rt_go_v2; the 4 in Rollup._commitBatch (A023-A026, the data-hash preimage) survive with the projected header document unchanged.

cmp_boundary (>= and > flipped): of the 23 mutants exactly A058 (Rollup.sol:333, version 1 gets the 249-byte length: K1) and A059 (Rollup.sol:353, version 1 skips the lastBlockNumber store: K2) are killed, each by L_par_hdr_v1 and L_rt_go_v1 and no other law; the other 21 survive.

cmp_boundary_mirror (<= and < flipped): of the 15 mutants exactly A081 (Rollup.sol:293, version 2 now reverts) is killed, by K2 on L_rt_go_v2 alone, with a partiality witness (a version-2 candidate at which the original code executes and the mutant's enc_sol reverts at :293); the other 14 survive. I60 forecast proof_lost_unwitnessed for A081; I61's partiality witness (S-A3) changes that.

Solidity decoders: none of the 31 getter mutants (mload_offset A092-A113, shr_width A114-A122) is killed and none changes the projected header document; the 6 tce mutants (A110-A113, A121, A122) change no extracted document.

The window view m1_view is byte-identical to the baseline's for every mutant, so all 15 M1x laws are carried with their baseline statuses in every record; none of the 7 drop_delete and 12 swap_cursor mutants is killed.

All 14 putuint64_offset mutants are killed: A123-A128 by L_par_hdr_v0 and A129-A135 by L_par_hdr_v1 through K1; A136 (PutUint64 on the 7-byte batchBytes[250:], a panic for every header) by L_par_hdr_v1 through K2 alone.

26 of the 28 copy_offset mutants are killed by K1 (the V0 encoder's by L_par_hdr_v0, the V1 encoder's by L_par_hdr_v1); A148 and A162 (the sequencerSetVerifyHash copy moved to 186, premise-limited) survive: under every codec law's ssvh = 0 premise the shifted zeros equal the original bytes.

go_slice_offset: all 24 mutants are killed by K1, by the round-trip laws whose version reads the getter: BlobVersionedHash (A177, A178) by L_rt_go_v0 and L_rt_go_v1, BlobHashesHash (A179, A180) by L_rt_go_v2, LastBlockNumber (A191, A192) by L_rt_go_v1 and L_rt_go_v2, every other getter by all three.

None of the 4 stratum-A drop_len_check mutants is killed. The three validate drops (A165-A167) show a masked obstruction on L_dom_hdr (a 1-byte header [v]: Go now accepts, Solidity rejects) and are filed rule_gap (law_unmoved); the Version drop (A168) shows none, leaves the projection unchanged and is filed extraction_gap (model).

Exactly 40 stratum-A mutants show a masked obstruction (a predicted law REFUTED at baseline whose model hit replays on the mutant code and not on the original): L_par_hdr_ssvh for 36 K1-killed codec mutants (A001, A003-A006, A008, A021, A027-A034, A058, A129-A135, A151-A161, A163, A164) and L_dom_hdr for A076 (BatchHeaderCodecV0.sol:32, a 249-byte version-0 header now rejected by Solidity) and A165-A167.
79 stratum-A mutants are killed by K1: the 96 kills less the 17 K2-only ones (A002, A007, A009-A017, A019, A020, A022, A059, A081, A136); k1_only.A counts them less any adjudicated equivalent.

None of the 50 stratum-B mutants is killed, including the 42 in a codec function (reporting.B_codec_functions); each has an empty predicted set and is filed rule_gap (no_law) or extraction_gap (frontend). The 14 genesis encoder mutants (B001-B008, B011-B016) and the 28 node/types mutants (B023-B050) change their extracted document.

Law families in stratum A (by_family, recomputed from the records): PAR-codec laws are predicted for 91 mutants and kill 71; PAR-round-trip for 77 and kill 56; PAR-domain for 6 and kill 0; M1x:DISCH, M1x:FACT, M1x:NAT, M1x:SORT, M1x:SYM and M1x:UNDO are each predicted for 100 and kill 0; M2:SORT/site is predicted for 99 and M2:SORT/width for 73, and both kill 0; no other family appears.
The i20_step corpus detects the 7 swapped cursors on paths its m1 traces exercise (A045 Rollup.sol:312, A047 :417, A048 :441, A049 :476, A050 and A051 :489, A052 :643).
Every stratum-A mutant except the 6 tce ones changes at least one extracted document (normalized), so no stratum-A survivor but those is a frontend-stage extraction gap.
No M2 law moves: in every record no M2 law, baseline or derived only on the mutant, is REFUTED unless it is REFUTED at baseline, and no PROVED M2 law loses its proof.

The harness gate passes at its first attempt: on the original code the harness reproduces I16's committed outputs of all six edges, agrees with the baseline model wherever the model is defined, falsifies no PROVED M0 law and replays every REFUTED M0 law's witness; the planted controls C1 and C2 are killed by K1 through L_par_hdr_v0, C3 by K1 through L_par_hdr_v1, and C4 by K2 with partiality witnesses through L_rt_go_v1 and L_rt_go_v2.
By language, stratum A: Solidity 32 of 122 killed, Go 64 of 70; stratum B (Go only): 0 of 50. Per site, 51 of stratum A's 127 sites are killed.
Every killed stratum-A mutant with a K2 law has a model-tied one (k2_model_tied.A.untied = 0); no mutant is filed baseline_finding or extraction_gap (replay); no obstruction is recomputed_only.
The plan-literal count of stratum A is 97 of 192: the 96 kills and A018, whose proof loss the plan's words count and K2 (c) does not.
